source: Oracle data dictionary (USER_* views) of a database installed and upgraded by the COMMON release 88 scripts

objects.name: XXFND_APPLICATIONS
objects.comment: Applications that use the shared access module (roles, features, users). APPLICATION_ID = internal key, never changed; APPLICATION_CODE / APEX_APP_ALIAS = the same in every environment; APEX_APPLICATION_ID = the APEX ID in this environment.

columns.name: APEX_APPLICATION_ID
columns.comment: APEX application ID in this environment (may differ between DEV / TEST / PROD); set at sign-in from the alias.

columns.name: SCHEMA_NAME
columns.comment: Database schema of the application's own objects (KYC: XXCUS; COMMON: XXFUSION, which owns the shared XXFND_ objects).

columns.name: EMAIL_ENABLED_FLAG
columns.comment: E-mail on / off for the application (the COMMON row: for the whole instance).

objects.name: XXFND_APPLICATION_FUNCTIONS
objects.comment: Common functions per application: MANAGED_IN_APP_FLAG Y = the application's administrators maintain its setup for their application (XXFND_APPLICATION_PKG.IS_MANAGED).

objects.name: XXFND_APPROVAL_RULES
objects.comment: Approval Setup: rules of a transaction type. The enabled rule whose conditions match most attributes applies; then the lowest priority.

objects.name: XXFND_APPROVAL_RULE_CONDS
objects.comment: Approval Setup: rule conditions (attribute = value; several values of one attribute = any of them).

objects.name: XXFND_APPROVAL_RULE_STEPS
objects.comment: Approval Setup: the approvers of a rule, in order (a role, a user or the requester).

constraints.name: XXFND_APPROVAL_RULE_STEPS_CK2
constraints.condition: (approver_type = 'ROLE' and role_code is not null)                                                  or (approver_type = 'USER' and user_name is not null)                                                  or approver_type = 'REQUESTER'

objects.name: XXFND_APPROVAL_TXNS
objects.comment: The approval of one transaction: the rule that applied and the approver whose turn it is (CURRENT_SEQ).

objects.name: XXFND_APPROVAL_TXN_STEPS
objects.comment: The approvers of one transaction in order: copied from its rule, plus the ad-hoc approvers added on the way.

objects.name: XXFND_APPROVAL_TYPES
objects.comment: Approval Setup: one transaction type per approval process of an application.

objects.name: XXFND_APPROVAL_TYPE_ATTRS
objects.comment: Approval Setup: the attributes a transaction type gives its rules (values from LOOKUP_TYPE when set).

objects.name: XXFND_APP_MENU_ENTRIES
objects.comment: The menu entries of each application for the common functions (release 87): made by XXFND_APPLICATION_PKG.ONBOARD / ENSURE_MENU or the application (REGISTER_MENU_ENTRY), maintained in COMMON; read through XXFND_APP_MENU_V.

columns.name: TARGET_TYPE
columns.comment: COMMON_PAGE: a COMMON page; APP_PAGE: a page of the application; MANAGED: a common function the application manages (COMMON page 99 for the application); SHARED_SETUP: COMMON Administration (page 100).

columns.name: FEATURE_CODE
columns.comment: The feature whose VIEW privilege shows the entry; empty = every signed-in user.

constraints.name: XXFND_APP_MENU_ENTRIES_CK4
constraints.condition: target_type in ('MANAGED', 'SHARED_SETUP') or page_id is not null

objects.name: XXFND_ATTACHED_DOCUMENTS
objects.comment: Links a document to any record of a registered entity (FND_ATTACHED_DOCUMENTS). Carries its own descriptive flexfield.

columns.name: EXPIRATION_DATE
columns.comment: Soft delete. A removed attachment keeps its row and audit history.

objects.name: XXFND_ATTACHMENT_BLK_ENTITIES
objects.comment: Which entity a region attaches to, which page items supply PK1-PK5, and what the user may do (FND_ATTACHMENT_BLK_ENTITIES).

objects.name: XXFND_ATTACHMENT_BLOCKS
objects.comment: A region on the page (FND_ATTACHMENT_BLOCKS), identified by its static ID.

objects.name: XXFND_ATTACHMENT_FUNCTIONS
objects.comment: An APEX page that shows attachments (FND_ATTACHMENT_FUNCTIONS). Keyed by application alias, which stays stable across imports; the numeric application ID does not.

columns.name: MAX_FILE_SIZE_MB
columns.comment: Largest file accepted on this page (MB) unless the category says otherwise; overrides the application default.

columns.name: ALLOWED_FILE_TYPES
columns.comment: File extensions accepted on this page unless the category says otherwise; overrides the application default.

objects.name: XXFND_AUDIT_LOG
objects.comment: Append-only change log for configuration tables, written by triggers that XXFND_AUDIT_PKG generates. Rows are never updated, so there are no WHO columns.

objects.name: XXFND_COMMUNICATIONS
objects.comment: E-mails with outside people per record (application, entity, key; optionally a request for information): sent from the application (APEX mail) or received and recorded (by hand now, Outlook later). NOT_SENT = recorded while e-mail is switched off.

columns.name: CONVERSATION_ID
columns.comment: Outlook conversation (thread) ID, filled by the Outlook integration later to match replies.

objects.name: XXFND_CONFIG_TABLES
objects.comment: Configuration tables per application: configuration audit (AUDIT_FLAG) and maker-checker approval (APPROVAL_FLAG, PK_COLUMN, UNIT_TABLE / UNIT_KEY_COLUMN, CHANGES_VIEW).

constraints.name: XXFND_CONFIG_TABLES_CK3
constraints.condition: approval_flag = 'N' or (pk_column is not null and changes_view is not null)

objects.name: XXFND_CONTACT_SOURCES
objects.comment: Release 88: the contacts of an application's records (a view of the application's schema with PK1_VALUE, CONTACT_NAME, EMAIL_ADDRESS), offered as recipients on the COMMON e-mail page.

objects.name: XXFND_DATA_RULE_ASSIGNMENTS
objects.comment: Who a data access rule applies to: a user or a role per row. A user sees the rows of every enabled rule assigned to them or to one of their active roles (access adds up).

constraints.name: XXFND_DATA_RULE_ASSIGN_CK1
constraints.condition: (user_id is null and role_code is not null) or (user_id is not null and role_code is null)

objects.name: XXFND_DATA_SECURITY_RULES
objects.comment: Row access per role and table. A user sees the union of the rows allowed by the enabled rules of their active roles; no rule = no rows (enforced by XXFND_VPD_PKG).

columns.name: ROLE_CODE
columns.comment: Until release 78 the only role of the rule; since release 79 the rule is assigned in XXFND_DATA_RULE_ASSIGNMENTS (this role became its first assignment).

columns.name: VALUE_LIST
columns.comment: COLUMN_IN_LIST: comma-separated values, e.g. AE,SA.

constraints.name: XXFND_DATA_SECURITY_RULES_CK2
constraints.condition: (rule_type = 'ALL_ROWS'       and column_name is null     and value_list is null) or         (rule_type = 'OWN_RECORDS'    and column_name is not null and value_list is null) or         (rule_type = 'COLUMN_IN_LIST' and column_name is not null and value_list is not null)

objects.name: XXFND_DF_CONTEXTS
objects.comment: Contexts (FND_DESCR_FLEX_CONTEXTS). GLOBAL segments show on every row; other contexts show when ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY matches.

columns.name: PROTECTED_FLAG
columns.comment: Y = seeded by the system; administrators cannot disable or delete it.

objects.name: XXFND_DF_FLEXFIELDS
objects.comment: One DFF per table (FND_DESCRIPTIVE_FLEXS). Registering a table here plus enabling contexts and segments is all it takes for every screen carrying the DFF region to render the fields.

columns.name: CONTEXT_REFERENCE_COLUMN
columns.comment: Derive the context from this column on the same row, e.g. JURISDICTION (FND_DEFAULT_CONTEXT_FIELDS).

columns.name: CONTEXT_USER_SELECTABLE_FLAG
columns.comment: Y = when no reference column, the user picks the context from a list.

objects.name: XXFND_DF_SEGMENTS
objects.comment: Segments (FND_DESCR_FLEX_COLUMN_USAGES): maps a field to one reserved column. XXFND_DFF_PKG also checks that the column family matches the value set format and that GLOBAL columns are not reused by other contexts.

columns.name: DEFAULT_VALUE
columns.comment: CONSTANT: the literal. SQL: a query returning one value; may reference :CONTEXT_CODE.

constraints.name: XXFND_DF_SEGMENTS_CK6
constraints.condition: default_type = 'NONE' or default_value is not null

objects.name: XXFND_DOCUMENTS
objects.comment: Document header (FND_DOCUMENTS). Files are held in UCM or SharePoint; the database keeps only the reference. Text and web-page documents need no external store.

columns.name: BASE_DOCUMENT_ID
columns.comment: First version of this document. Null on the first version; later versions point back to it.

columns.name: EXTERNAL_DOCUMENT_ID
columns.comment: UCM dDocName, or SharePoint drive item ID.

columns.name: EXTERNAL_VERSION_ID
columns.comment: UCM dID, or SharePoint version label.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_DATE
columns.comment: Issue date printed on the document. Checked against the category's MAX_AGE_DAYS.

columns.name: UPLOAD_STATUS
columns.comment: PENDING until the external store confirms the file; FAILED keeps the error in UPLOAD_ERROR so nothing is silently lost.

columns.name: AUTOMATED_CHECK_STATUS
columns.comment: Reserved for an automated authenticity check (integration purpose DOC_AUTHENTICITY).

columns.name: SERVER_CODE
columns.comment: Release 86: the server (XXFND_SERVERS) the file was stored on; empty for the database.

columns.name: STORAGE_CONTAINER
columns.comment: Release 86: the SharePoint document library (drive ID) or the Object Storage bucket the file was stored in.

constraints.name: XXFND_DOCUMENTS_CK4
constraints.condition: (datatype_code = 'FILE'     and storage_type in ('UCM','SHAREPOINT','DATABASE','OBJECT_STORAGE') and file_name is not null) or             (datatype_code = 'WEB_PAGE' and url is not null and storage_type is null) or             (datatype_code in ('SHORT_TEXT','LONG_TEXT') and storage_type is null)

columns.name: HAS_EXPIRY_FLAG
columns.comment: Y = the document itself expires (passport, licence); an expiry date is required on upload.

columns.name: MAX_AGE_DAYS
columns.comment: How recent the document must be when submitted (e.g. utility bill within 90 days). Separate from expiry.

columns.name: MAX_FILE_SIZE_MB
columns.comment: Largest file accepted for this category (MB); overrides the page and the application default.

columns.name: ALLOWED_FILE_TYPES
columns.comment: File extensions accepted for this category, comma-separated (e.g. pdf,jpg); * = any; overrides the page and the application default.

objects.name: XXFND_DOCUMENT_ENTITIES
objects.comment: Registered attachable entities (FND_DOCUMENT_ENTITIES). Gives ATTACHED_DOCUMENTS.ENTITY_NAME a real foreign key.

objects.name: XXFND_DOCUMENT_FILES
objects.comment: File bytes of attachments stored in the database (xxfnd_documents.storage_type = DATABASE; external_document_id / external_version_id = file_id). One row per version.

objects.name: XXFND_DOC_CATEGORY_USAGES
objects.comment: Categories a page may offer (FND_DOC_CATEGORY_USAGES). A page with no rows here offers every enabled category.

objects.name: XXFND_EMPLOYEES
objects.comment: One row per person. FUSION rows are maintained by the Fusion HCM sync and are read-only in the application; LOCAL rows are maintained by an administrator.

columns.name: FUSION_USER_ID
columns.comment: Fusion user account id (HCM userAccounts UserId), set by the HCM sync.

columns.name: USER_NAME
columns.comment: Sign-in name: the Fusion / identity-domain user name (upper case); the work e-mail until the HCM sync finds a user account.

constraints.name: XXFND_EMPLOYEES_CK2
constraints.condition: (source_type = 'FUSION' and fusion_person_id is not null) or         (source_type = 'LOCAL'  and fusion_person_id is null)

objects.name: XXFND_ENTITY_CONTAINERS
objects.comment: The external folder created for one record, so later files land in the same place.

objects.name: XXFND_ERROR_LOG
objects.comment: Unexpected errors of every application; ERROR_ID is the reference shown to the user.

objects.name: XXFND_FEATURES
objects.comment: Application features (one menu entry each). Privileges are granted per feature and action.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.comment: The application (XXFND_APPLICATIONS) the feature belongs to; its privileges and page mappings follow it.

columns.name: HOME_PAGE_ID
columns.comment: Page opened by the feature's menu entry.

objects.name: XXFND_FEATURE_PAGES
objects.comment: Which feature an APEX page belongs to. Page authorization checks the privilege of this feature.

columns.name: TAB_LABEL
columns.comment: Tab shown on every list page of the same feature; null = not a tab (forms, dialogs).

objects.name: XXFND_INTEGRATION_CALLS
objects.comment: Release 83: every call made through XXFND_INTEGRATION_PKG (purpose, server, record) with what is needed to retry it; the HTTP details are in APEX_WEBSERVICE_LOG (WEBSERVICE_LOG_ID). File transfers are logged but not retried (RETRYABLE_FLAG N).

objects.name: XXFND_INTEGRATION_PURPOSES
objects.comment: Which endpoint serves each business purpose, and whether it runs manually or by API. Changes take effect only after a second person approves them.

columns.name: ENDPOINT_CODE
columns.comment: Before release 86: the retired integration endpoint. No longer read (SERVER_CODE).

columns.name: REST_SOURCE_STATIC_ID
columns.comment: Release 83: the REST Data Source of the COMMON application that serves the purpose (static ID); its Remote Server and Web Credential are kept by the workspace administrator.

columns.name: SERVER_CODE
columns.comment: Release 86: the server (XXFND_SERVERS) the purpose uses; a REST Data Source, when set, keeps its own Remote Server.

constraints.name: XXFND_INT_PURPOSES_CK5
constraints.condition: capture_method = 'MANUAL' or rest_source_static_id is not null or server_code is not null

objects.name: XXFND_LOOKUP_TYPES
objects.comment: Lookup type header (FND_LOOKUP_TYPES). APPLICATION_CODE null = shared by every application.

columns.name: CUSTOMIZATION_LEVEL
columns.comment: S = system (values locked), E = extensible (values may be added), U = user (fully editable).

objects.name: XXFND_LOOKUP_VALUES
objects.comment: Lookup values (FND_LOOKUP_VALUES). Parent columns support dependent (cascading) values.

columns.name: TAG
columns.comment: One extra attribute for a value, e.g. a jurisdiction's UBO threshold. Needs more than one? Use a dedicated table.

constraints.name: XXFND_LOOKUP_VALUES_CK2
constraints.condition: end_date_active is null or end_date_active >= start_date_active

objects.name: XXFND_MESSAGES
objects.comment: Message catalogue: user messages by code and language ({1}..{n} = values). A constraint name as code gives that rule a readable message.

columns.name: ERROR_NUMBER
columns.comment: Oracle error number raised for the message (-20000..-20999); empty = -20000.

objects.name: XXFND_NOTIFICATIONS
objects.comment: Release 84: every notification made, one row per person and channel, with its delivery status (SKIPPED with the reason, e.g. e-mail switched off or no device subscribed). The IN_APP rows are the person's notification list; READ_DATE is set when it is opened.

constraints.name: XXFND_NOTIFICATIONS_CK2
constraints.condition: user_name is not null or email_address is not null

objects.name: XXFND_NOTIFICATION_TEMPLATES
objects.comment: Wording of every system email and alert. Placeholders use #TOKEN# syntax and are replaced at send time.

columns.name: BODY_HTML
columns.comment: Before release 82: the message as HTML. Kept; read only when MESSAGE_TEXT is empty (tags dropped).

columns.name: MESSAGE_TEXT
columns.comment: Release 82: the message as plain text with #TOKEN# placeholders; the layout (links, formatting, direction) comes from the APEX Email Template XXFND_STANDARD.

objects.name: XXFND_NOTIFY_CHANNELS
objects.comment: Release 84: the channels a notification is delivered on (in the application, e-mail, push, Fusion). DELIVERY_PROCEDURE takes the notification ID; INTEGRATION_PURPOSE is the COMMON integration purpose a remote channel calls; INBOX_FLAG Y = its notifications are the person's notification list (the bell).

objects.name: XXFND_NOTIFY_EVENTS
objects.comment: Release 84: notification events. TRIGGER_CODE is what raises the event (an APEX task event CREATE, COMPLETE, REQUEST_INFO, SUBMIT_INFO; a deadline REMINDER, ESCALATION; an RFI step), OUTCOME_CODE narrows a completion (APPROVED, REJECTED). The link is the page LINK_PAGE_ALIAS of application LINK_APPLICATION_CODE (empty = the task's own application), with LINK_ITEMS set from the event values LINK_TOKENS; LINK_PUBLIC_FLAG Y for a page opened without an account.

objects.name: XXFND_NOTIFY_RECIPIENT_TYPES
objects.comment: Release 84: who a notification goes to, as a query returning USER_NAME (optionally EMAIL_ADDRESS and LANGUAGE_CODE for a person without an account). Binds: :TASK_ID, :WORKFLOW_ID, :DETAIL_PK, :APPLICATION_CODE, :PROCESS_CODE, :VALUE.

objects.name: XXFND_NOTIFY_RULES
objects.comment: Release 84: who is told of an event on which channel. APPLICATION_CODE / PROCESS_CODE empty = every application / process; TEMPLATE_CODE empty = the event's wording.

objects.name: XXFND_PRIVILEGES
objects.comment: VIEW = open and read; CREATE = new records; MANAGE = change existing records (edit, delete, actions).

columns.name: APPLICATION_CODE
columns.comment: Application the policy belongs to; empty = shared by all applications.

objects.name: XXFND_RFIS
objects.comment: Requests for information of every application: one row per RFI; its questions and answers are in XXFND_RFI_ROUNDS.

columns.name: RECIPIENT_REFERENCE
columns.comment: The application's own key of the recipient (KYC: party contact ID).

columns.name: RESPONSE_TOKEN_HASH
columns.comment: SHA-256 hash of the one-time token e-mailed to an external person. The token itself is never stored.

constraints.name: XXFND_RFIS_CK4
constraints.condition: (recipient_type = 'USER' and recipient_user_name is not null)                                   or (recipient_type = 'EXTERNAL' and (recipient_email is not null or recipient_reference is not null))

objects.name: XXFND_RFI_ROUNDS
objects.comment: Each question of an RFI and its answer and review: the RFI loops (asked again) until resolved.

objects.name: XXFND_ROLES
objects.comment: Application roles. Enforced by APEX authorization schemes that call XXFND_USER_PKG.AUTHORIZED.

objects.name: XXFND_ROLE_PRIVILEGES
objects.comment: Privileges granted to a role. Maintained on the Roles and Privileges screen.

objects.name: XXFND_SERVERS
objects.comment: Release 86: the servers of the workspace, defined once by the COMMON administrator. SERVER_CODE = the static ID of the APEX Remote Server (workspace component); its secret is the APEX Web Credential CREDENTIAL_STATIC_ID. Storage servers: OBJECT_STORAGE (OCI region, namespace), SHAREPOINT (Microsoft Graph, OAuth token URL), UCM (WebCenter Content); integration servers: FUSION, REST, OUTLOOK (Microsoft Graph). The database needs no server.

columns.name: BASE_URL
columns.comment: Used only while no APEX Remote Server of SERVER_CODE exists (copied from the retired XXFND_INTEGRATION_ENDPOINTS); the Remote Server URL wins.

columns.name: CREDENTIAL_STATIC_ID
columns.comment: Static ID of the APEX Web Credential; empty = of a COMMON REST Data Source on the Remote Server, else <SERVER_CODE>_CREDENTIALS.

columns.name: OAUTH_TOKEN_URL
columns.comment: SHAREPOINT / OUTLOOK (Microsoft Graph): OAuth2 client-credentials token URL (not a secret).

columns.name: OCI_REGION
columns.comment: OBJECT_STORAGE: OCI region, e.g. eu-frankfurt-1 (URL https://objectstorage.<region>.oraclecloud.com when there is no Remote Server).

columns.name: OCI_NAMESPACE
columns.comment: OBJECT_STORAGE: the Object Storage namespace of the tenancy.

objects.name: XXFND_SERVER_TESTS
objects.comment: Release 83: the last Test Connection of each APEX Remote Server (Servers screen health).

objects.name: XXFND_SETUP_TYPES
objects.comment: Setup types and the level they are kept at: I instance only (application empty), A application only, B either; ALL_APPLICATIONS_FLAG N = only the applications in XXFND_SETUP_TYPE_APPS.

objects.name: XXFND_SETUP_TYPE_APPS
objects.comment: Applications a setup type may be kept for (when its ALL_APPLICATIONS_FLAG is N).

objects.name: XXFND_SOD_RULES
objects.comment: Role pairs that one person may not both exercise within CONFLICT_SCOPE. Stored in canonical order so a pair cannot be entered twice.

columns.name: CONFLICT_SCOPE
columns.comment: Lookup SOD_SCOPE, e.g. SAME_RECORD (same case) or GLOBAL (never both roles).

objects.name: XXFND_STORAGE_CONFIG
objects.comment: Where files are stored: Oracle UCM (WebCenter Content) or SharePoint. The most specific row wins (entity + category, then entity, then category, then the default row with both null); PRIORITY breaks ties.

columns.name: ENTITY_NAME
columns.comment: Before release 86: the entity of the rule. No longer read (storage is per application and category).

columns.name: CATEGORY_CODE
columns.comment: Release 86: empty = the application default row; a category = that category's overrides (empty fields = the application's).

columns.name: STORAGE_TYPE
columns.comment: Release 86: the server's type (UCM, SHAREPOINT, OBJECT_STORAGE), DATABASE (no server; on a category row: this category in the database), empty on a category row = as the application.

columns.name: ENDPOINT_CODE
columns.comment: Before release 86: the retired integration endpoint. No longer read (SERVER_CODE).

columns.name: FOLDER_PATH_TEMPLATE
columns.comment: Folder for new files. Tokens: #CATEGORY# (= #CATEGORY_CODE#), #ENTITY_NAME#, #PK1_VALUE#..#PK5_VALUE#, #YYYY#. Empty: the application's, else /#CATEGORY#/#ENTITY_NAME#/#PK1_VALUE#.

columns.name: SHAREPOINT_SITE_ID
columns.comment: Release 86: SharePoint site (Microsoft Graph site ID).

columns.name: SHAREPOINT_DRIVE_ID
columns.comment: Release 86: SharePoint document library (Microsoft Graph drive ID).

columns.name: APPLICATION_CODE
columns.comment: Application the storage rule belongs to; release 86: empty = COMMON (the instance), not a default for the other applications.

columns.name: SERVER_CODE
columns.comment: Release 86: the workspace server (XXFND_SERVERS). Application row: empty = the database. Category row: empty = the application's server.

columns.name: BUCKET_NAME
columns.comment: Release 86: OCI Object Storage bucket.

constraints.name: XXFND_STORAGE_CONFIG_CK4
constraints.condition: storage_type is null or storage_type in ('UCM','SHAREPOINT','OBJECT_STORAGE','DATABASE')

objects.name: XXFND_TASK_ALERTS
objects.comment: Deadline reminders and escalations already sent, so each goes out once per task.

objects.name: XXFND_TASK_SETTINGS
objects.comment: Per APEX task definition (static ID): due date in days from creation, reminder before it, role that receives overdue tasks, e-mail on creation.

objects.name: XXFND_TRANSMISSIONS
objects.comment: Business-level log of every outbound call, tied to the record it served. Binary payloads are not stored; REQUEST_PAYLOAD holds metadata only for file uploads.

columns.name: ENDPOINT_CODE
columns.comment: Before release 86: the retired integration endpoint (this log is no longer written: XXFND_INTEGRATION_CALLS).

objects.name: XXFND_USERS
objects.comment: Users of all applications. SSO = linked to an employee, signs in with the identity domain (no password); LOCAL = no employee, Oracle APEX account (APEX keeps the password).

columns.name: USER_NAME
columns.comment: Sign-in name, upper case. SSO: the employee's user name (identity-domain user name); LOCAL: the APEX account name.

columns.name: LANGUAGE_CODE
columns.comment: Language of the user's notifications (lookup LANGUAGE: en, ar); default English.

constraints.name: XXFND_USERS_CK2
constraints.condition: (user_type = 'SSO' and employee_id is not null) or (user_type = 'LOCAL' and employee_id is null)

constraints.name: XXFND_USERS_CK5
constraints.condition: end_date_active is null or end_date_active >= start_date_active

constraints.name: XXFND_USER_ROLES_CK2
constraints.condition: end_date_active is null or end_date_active >= start_date_active

indexes.name: XXFND_USER_ROLES_U2
columns: CASE  WHEN ("END_DATE_ACTIVE" IS NULL AND "USER_ID" IS NOT NULL) THEN "USER_ID" END
CASE  WHEN ("END_DATE_ACTIVE" IS NULL AND "USER_ID" IS NOT NULL) THEN "ROLE_CODE" END

objects.name: XXFND_VALUE_SETS
objects.comment: Segment validation (FND_FLEX_VALUE_SETS). INDEPENDENT/DEPENDENT sets draw values from the Lookup engine; DEPENDENT uses the parent columns on XXFND_LOOKUP_VALUES.

columns.name: TABLE_QUERY
columns.comment: TABLE validation only. Must return RETURN_VALUE and DISPLAY_VALUE; may reference :CONTEXT_CODE.

columns.name: APPLICATION_CODE
columns.comment: Application the value set belongs to; empty = shared by all applications.

constraints.name: XXFND_VALUE_SETS_CK4
constraints.condition: (validation_type = 'NONE'        and lookup_type is null and table_query is null) or         (validation_type = 'INDEPENDENT' and lookup_type is not null and format_type = 'CHAR') or         (validation_type = 'DEPENDENT'   and lookup_type is not null and parent_value_set_code is not null and format_type = 'CHAR') or         (validation_type = 'TABLE'       and table_query is not null)

objects.name: XXFND_WF_DELEGATIONS
objects.comment: Delegations (vacation rules): tasks of the delegator are also offered to the delegate between the dates. Read by XXFND_WORKFLOW_PKG.VACATION_RULE.

columns.name: TASK_DEFINITION
columns.comment: Task definition static ID; null = every task.

objects.name: XXFND_WORKFLOW_PROCESSES
objects.comment: Workflow processes (APEX workflow static ID) per application: approval workflow on / off (off = auto-approved) and e-mail on / off.

columns.name: PARTICIPANTS_TYPE
columns.comment: Who acts on the process: RULE = the Approval Setup rules decide; CHOSEN = the user who starts it chooses (e.g. the recipient of a request for information).

objects.name: XXFND_APP_MENU_V
objects.comment: Release 87: the menu of an application for the common functions, for the signed-in user (an APEX list: lvl, label, target, is_current, image ...).

objects.name: XXFND_APP_STORAGE_V
objects.comment: Release 86: storage of each registered application (CATEGORY_CODE empty = the application default) and of each of its categories: the row's own values, the EFFECTIVE_* value of each field (category, else application, else the default folder), EFFECTIVE_STORAGE_TYPE (what an upload uses) and STATE (OK, or INCOMPLETE - using database with INCOMPLETE_REASON).

objects.name: XXFND_ATTACHED_DOCUMENTS_V
objects.comment: Attachments not removed, with category and title resolved. XXFND_ATTACH_PKG.ADD_VERSION repoints the attachment to the newest version, so DOCUMENT_ID is always the current one.

objects.name: XXFND_CONFIG_CHANGES_V
objects.comment: Maker-checker changes waiting for approval, one row per CONFIG_CHANGE approval task (DETAIL_PK), from every application.

objects.name: XXFND_DOCUMENT_VERSIONS_V
objects.comment: Every stored version of a file; filter by BASE_DOCUMENT_ID for one document's history.

objects.name: XXFND_EFFECTIVE_ACCESS_V
objects.comment: The data access rules that apply to each user, directly or through an active role.

objects.name: XXFND_INTEGRATION_CHANGES_V
objects.comment: Pending integration purpose changes (registered changes view of XXFND_INTEGRATION_PURPOSES).

objects.name: XXFND_MODULES_V
objects.comment: COMMON modules (lookup XXFND_MODULE) the current user may open, with their state.

objects.name: XXFND_QA_HISTORY_V
objects.comment: Release 82: questions and answers of a record in one list - APEX task comments (Request Information, Submit Information, decisions) and the questions and answers of its requests for information.

objects.name: XXFND_SERVERS_V
objects.comment: Release 86: the servers (XXFND_SERVERS) with their usage (STORAGE / INTEGRATION), effective URL (APEX Remote Server, else the copied URL, else the OCI region URL) and Web Credential, health, and STATUS: DISABLED, INCOMPLETE (MISSING says what), FAILED (last Test Connection) or OK.

objects.name: XXFND_SETUP_COLUMNS_V
objects.comment: Columns of the tables in XXFND_SETUP_TABLES_V.

objects.name: XXFND_SETUP_ROWS_V
objects.comment: Every setup row with its application (empty: all applications - instance) and the COMMON form item that opens it.

objects.name: XXFND_SETUP_TABLES_V
objects.comment: Tables the COMMON setup forms list: each registered application's schema (APPLICATION_CODE) and this schema (empty: every application).
